D.label: DOOR
D.name: Lab door
D.text: The lab door. It opens when you have read the two cards.

N.label: NOTICE
N.name: Notice board
N.text: Today: one spring scale, four rigs. What does each string, rod and link hold?

C.label: STEP CARD
C.name: Step card
C.text: The step card lists every step of the lab, in order.

S.label: SCALE BENCH
S.name: Scale bench
S.text: The scale bench: a spring scale, a ruler, a cart and pulley, a walkway model and a hanging chain. Press E to use it.
